content.text: A mobile app for film production session management and version review

The internal teams at VigaET relied heavily on Movie Colab Projects for their animation and film production. However, they faced a key challenge: tracking and logging work sessions throughout the day was cumbersome. We developed a simple desktop tool that allowed artists to submit work and link it to their sessions in the web app. But this wasn’t the final solution.

content.heading: The Intro
content.para: Movie Colab Projects is a film production management web platform that centralizes the animation and live-action workflow. Films are structured hierarchically; divided into sequences, then individual shots, and each shot goes through multiple iterations before approval. Artists are assigned tasks to refine shots and submit them for review by directors or department heads. Managing this complex, multi-stage process is challenging. Movie Colab solves this by consolidating version management, review workflows, and task tracking into a single platform.

content.heading: The Feedback
content.para: Based on feedback from both groups, we identified a clear need: artists wanted a mobile app to manage sessions on the go, and reviewers needed an app to receive project updates and review versions from anywhere, not just from their desks.
